label: Tanec · Bharatanátjam
desc: Půldřep, mudry u hrudi, dupání se zvonky, výpad na patu, namaste s úsměvem.
desc_en: Half-squat, mudras at the chest, stamping with ankle bells, a lunge onto the heel, namaste with a smile.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: the dancer sinks into a deep half-squat with knees bent outward and arms held level, and holds the pose
the dancer forms precise mudra hand gestures near their chest as their head moves rhythmically side to side, and ends with hands joined at the chest
the dancer stamps their feet sharply three times, ankle bells ringing, and ends with feet together
the dancer extends one leg forward onto its heel, gaze following their outstretched fingertips, and holds the line
the dancer brings their palms together in front of their chest in a namaste gesture, smiles peacefully at the camera, and holds
